explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/60: does every n-vertex graph with more than ex(n; C₄) edges contain ≫ n^{1/2} copies of C₄? Copies of C₄ are counted as subgraphs H' of G isomorphic to cycleGraph 4, i.e. non-induced copies, each a vertex set with its 4 edges, and ex(n; C₄) is extremalNumber n (cycleGraph 4). The statement asks for c > 0 such that, for all large n, every such G has ≥ c√n copies. Faithful. The page poses this as a question, but the declaration has no @[question] tag.
